biocs.name: Recurring DNS access to rare domain
biocs.description: Detects repeated DNS queries to a domain with low historical lookup count
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_DNS_QUERY
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter action_domain_name = 'rare-domain-123.com'
| comp count() as cnt by action_domain_name
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname > 3
